body: Team mode is decided once in updates::classify via Allowlist::is_team (>1 id): from_name is None for one person, so content, meta and decision edits stay byte-identical to before. Alternative rejected: pass the allowlist size down to slots and decide per use.

Author name = username, else first_name (username is unique in a team; first names collide). Cleaned: whitespace runs -> one space, controls/bidi/zero-width and <>" dropped, cut to 32 UTF-16 units. Alternative: first name first (friendlier, ambiguous).

Burst meta from_name = the sole author when every part has the same one, omitted when parts differ (each part's content still starts with its author). Alternative rejected: last part's author, which would mislabel earlier parts.

Only permission decisions are signed (the edited result of a press). Resume, status stop and update presses produce no edited result message (toast answers and later notices), so they are not signed. Presser name set in Slots::press on the Open -> decided transition only.
User gained first_name, which pushed scheduler::Outcome over clippy large_enum_variant; boxed Message.from instead of allowing the lint or boxing Outcome::Sent.
